notes: QuietPayToken (src/QuietPayToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC20 named QuietPay with symbol QUIETPAY and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the factory. There is no owner, minter, pause, blocklist, fee, burn-on-transfer or any other privileged function, so the supply can never grow and every launch flow (factory to distributor, pool seed, remainder, claims and swaps) moves exactly what it says. The launch deploys no application contracts. The factory takes the swarm's share, seeds the pool with the requester's economics and forwards the remainder to economics.remainderTo; pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
